name: OS Abstraction
description: Operating system I/O abstraction layer providing platform-independent text and binary output, file writing, and OS-specific implementations. All higher layers depend on this for output.

name: Binary Libraries
description: Third-party and support binary format libraries including JVM classfile reading/writing (jx), JCPU VM support, and binary format utilities.

name: Semantic Analysis
description: Symbol resolution and relation analysis: resolves method symbols, RTE symbols, raw symbols; manages inter-element relations. Depends on OS abstraction for output.

name: Runtime Support
description: Runtime support for real number emulation (floating point) providing both emulated and native implementations.

name: Output Format
description: Output format writers for compiled code: bootable image output, Intel HEX, raw binary output, and the output factory/format abstractions. Depends on OS abstraction.

name: Entry Point
description: Compiler entry points and user interface: boot loader, standalone compiler (SC), and GUI compiler (SCG). Depends on all compilation layers.

name: Demo Applications
description: Sample applications, runtime environment classes (DynamicAri, DynamicRuntime, SArray, SIntfDesc, SIntfMap, SMthdBlock), standard library stubs (String, FLASH, STRUCT), demo source files, and test code.

name: Project Artifacts
description: Build outputs (compiled binaries, HEX files, disk images) and IDE configuration files (NetBeans project config, understand-anything ignore rules).
